name: service_meta_label
label: Service Meta Label (SD4)
help_text: Label prefix for the service meta block shown ABOVE the form when the member arrives via a service detail page (URL has ?service=<hubdb_row_id>). Blank on all other referrals.

name: service_context_description
label: Service-Context Description (SD4)
help_text: Alternate description shown IN PLACE of the default description when the member arrived from a service detail page. Client-provided copy — leave as default or edit anytime.
default: Refer them directly to this service and we'll help them get started. You'll be able to track the referral in My Referrals and may earn points or discounts for this service for both yourself and your referee if they proceed.

name: heading
label: Form Heading
help_text: Heading shown above the form card.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: description
label: Form Description (optional)
help_text: Optional description shown below the heading, inside the card.

name: form
label: Referral Form
help_text: Select the referral submission form. Create it first in HubSpot Marketing > Forms.

default.message: Thank you! Your referral has been submitted.
